more_beautiful.reason: A is richer and more finished: a confident display headline, a cohesive cream/forest-green/mustard palette, alternating section backgrounds, and crafted details like the yellow luggage tag, the hazard-tape 'can't fix' panel and the booking form's 'Busiest' and 'Last slot' chips. B uses one flat tan background throughout and turns into plain text lists in cards after its nice hero.

less_generic.reason: B builds the whole page around one idea, the kraft-paper repair tag (manila tag with string, rubber 'Free' stamp, slab-serif ink, little boxes showing places left per slot), so it feels made for this cafe. A sits on the stock AI landing-page skeleton (eyebrow labels, two pill CTAs, icon-in-circle cards, dashed 1-2-3 steps, plus-icon FAQ, offset-shadow neo-brutalism) with repair-themed flourishes on top.
